NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_07_SUMMERNIGHTS_2_INT: {SAY:winnie}I don't think this will be a simple one time endeavour.
{SAY:winnie}We may need to return to this beach over the course of our party preparations.
{SAY:winnie}Hopefully User Dave is doing his part to take care of the zombies back at home.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_07_SUMMERNIGHTS_3_INT: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave. Why do I keep seeing zombies appearing in our front lawn?
{SAY:crazydave}Some that may or may not have zombies in them.
{SAY:crazydave}It becomes a blur past a certain point.
{SAY:crazydave}Sometimes you wanna keep in touch after a wild night of partying, y'know?
{SAY:winnie}I cannot even think of a scenario unfolding, but I find arguing the feasability of such events to be moot.
{SAY:winnie}I am enacting a strict no-zombie rule on the guest list, User Dave.
{SAY:winnie}You're going to have to tell these guys to go.
{SAY:winnie}Need I remind you that the party is scheduled to be a week from now?
{SAY:winnie}We'll need the house to be clean in that amount of time.
{TIRED:winnie}User Dave. Is there something you're not telling me?
{TIRED:crazydave}I might have invited some of them by mistake.
{SAY:winnie}How do you accidentally invite zombies to your party?
{SAY:crazydave}Look, Penny. When you're as much of a party-goer as I am...
{SAY:crazydave}You'd have gone through thousands of these parties.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_07_SUMMERNIGHTS_4_INT: {SAY:winnie}Again, this is done under User Dave's requests.
{SAY:winnie}He is of the opinion that the party would be livelier with even more beverages.
{SAY:winnie}Unluckily for us, his requested brand of beverage is one recalled in the early 1990s.
{SAY:winnie}This time period is the only place we'll be able to retrieve it from.
{SAY:winnie}Look alive! Some zombies might not take kindly to us taking these precious resources away.
{TIRED:winnie}Pardon the sarcasm. These preparations are proven to be tiring.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_07_SUMMERNIGHTS_5_INT: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:winnie}User Dave, why are there still zombies on the lawn?
{TIRED:winnie}I thought I told you to rid of them when I went out to buy those colas.
{SAY:winnie}Then why do I see invitation cards in the possession of the zombies we're cleaning out?
{EXCITED:crazydave}I have no idea! I already turned zombies that I invited away yesterday!
{SAY:winnie}I'll put aside some time to investigate after I'm done handling the fireworks shipment.
{SAY:winnie}In the meantime, I entrust you with bouncer duty.
{SAY:winnie}Hopefully this should be the last of them.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_07_SUMMERNIGHTS_8_INT: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Look, Penny, I know what you're thinking, but I swear, it's not me.
{SAY:winnie}And what would that perfectly good explanation be?
{NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{TIRED:winnie}I cannot rationally comprehend what just happened.
{SAY:winnie}Regardless of that perplexing encounter, there are more zombies that need taken care of.
{SAY:winnie}These Missile Toes I hired as performers...
{SAY:winnie}...they have a very strict policy of not performing with zombies around.
{EXCITED:crazydave}Drats! We can't lose the main act!
{EXCITED:crazydave}Neighbor! It's up to you to save this party!
{SAY:winnie}Then who can it be? Someone is inviting all these zombies to our party.
{SAY:winnie}I'm not doing it, neither is your neighbor. So who could it-
{SAY:zombossicon}This is not what it looks like!
{SAY:crazydave}Are you tricking your zombies into thinking they were invited to our party, Boss Man?
{SAY:zombossicon}I assure you that there's a perfectly good explanation for this.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_08_BIGBRAINZ_10_INTRO: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}I've been conducting my own research on the nature of the past recent "experiments."
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Not your zombies? But aren't you supposed to be the Boss Man?
{SAY:zombossicon}I am the Boss Man! But some times, some idiots think they've got what it takes to overthrow me.
{SAY:zombossicon}How preposterous! No zombie matches my superior intellect!
{SAY:zombossicon}Normally, I care not for their short-lived rebellious attempts, but this one in particular intrigues me.
{SAY:zombossicon}If I'm right about who's behind this- and I usually am, this has the potential to be most entertaining!
{SAY:winnie}Do you care to elaborate on that?
{SAY:zombossicon}Perhaps I'd tell you if you survive some of my own research!
{SAY:zombossicon}The advancements of the future are here, and with them comes Power Tiles!
{SAY:zombossicon}Check out this technology and let's see what you make of it!
{TIRED:winnie}It shouldn't come as a surprise at this point.
{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}I see that you cretins have taken an interest in higher education!
{SAY:zombossicon}Have my academic achievements become a point of envy for the below average-intellect?
{SAY:winnie}Do not flatter yourself, Zomboss. We are simply partaking as consultants for some of your zombies' research.
{SAY:zombossicon}Yes, you are! But I'm afraid there's a slight miscalculation in your thesis.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_08_BIGBRAINZ_12_INTRO: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}User Dave, my investigations have shown something interesting.
{PLAYFUL:winnie}That should be a good thing. But let's not worry about that for now.
{SAY:winnie}It seems Zomboss has thoughtfully left us a puzzle to preoccupy ourselves with in their place.
{SAY:winnie}Not quite. But there seems to be a recent internal power struggle amongst the zombies.
{EXCITED:winnie}Some of the more "educated" zombies have grown unsatisfied with Zomboss' continuous failures.
{SAY:winnie}This lines up with what Dr. Zomboss had corroborated earlier.
{SAY:crazydave}Wait. You're saying that these frat zombies are... what?
{SAY:crazydave}Trying to take away Boss Man's Boss-manship?
{SAY:winnie}We can't say for sure, but there's high likelihood that they are.
{TIRED:crazydave}That'll explain why they haven't been around. I haven't seen them in days.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_08_BIGBRAINZ_13_INTRO: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}So, I was right! It really was those guys!
{SAY:zombossicon}HA-HA-HA!
{SAY:crazydave}Wow, Boss Man. What a bully!
{SAY:zombossicon}What a shame, cause I'm going to throw the biggest graduation party there is - all without them!
{SAY:zombossicon}And I'll send them all straight to your house! MWA-HA-HA! I'm so smart!
{NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{SAY:winnie}Seems we solved that little mystery of where your frat friends went off to, User Dave.
{SAY:crazydave}Boss Man seems really happy to be rid of them.
{TIRED:winnie}I daresay this won't be the last we see of them.
{SAY:winnie}It seems like they really have it in for Dr. Zomboss. And they're probably not going to stop here.
{SAY:winnie}Dr. Zomboss might not acknowledge them as a threat for now, but his hubris has always been his greatest weakness.
{SAY:winnie}But we can save that talk for later. We have a rampaging horde of fresh graduates marching to our location.
{SAY:crazydave}You seem really happy, Boss Man.
{SAY:crazydave}Really? Cause I don't see them.
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Maybe they just find the entry qualifications for our lawn too complex!
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}I can relate. I've never been good with Beghouled!
{SAY:zombossicon}I am! Oh, to see those losers I used to shove into lockers in college again!
{SAY:zombossicon}You know why they had paused their research earlier?
{SAY:zombossicon}They were trying to discredit my accolades and revoke my Thanatology degree!
{SAY:zombossicon}They can try their hardest! They'll never prove that I stole that thesis off someone else!
{SAY:winnie}Wait, what?
{SAY:zombossicon}And due to that pointless endeavor, they didn't have time to complete their research!
{SAY:zombossicon}Now they're gonna have to repeat their final year, for the tenth year in a row!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_08_BIGBRAINZ_1_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, may I inquire you about our current whereabouts?
{SAY:crazydave}So they said they were going to let me go if I help out with their final project!
{SAY:winnie}I'd take their final project for university involves something about breaching lawn defenses?
{SAY:crazydave}Something like that. You know those cuckoo researcher types!
{EXCITED:crazydave}They said they were conducting research about the efficiency of Vasebreaking!
{SAY:winnie}Which would explain the vases on the lawn. Understood.
{EXCITED:crazydave}Well, neighbor, you're a good Vasebreaker, aren't you? Mind lending a hand?
{TIRED:winnie}I'd say it's best for us to just to follow along for now.
{SAY:winnie}Be mindful of the vases you break, as usual.
{SAY:winnie}I certainly do not recollect traveling back to Egyptian times on my own accord.
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}I went out to a party last night, you know, with some frat guys-
{TIRED:winnie}No need to explain further, User Dave.
{TIRED:winnie}I'd take that you have somehow gotten into a situation with these, "frat zombies."
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}I'd lost a bet! And they were going to take away my brains! I still need those.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_08_BIGBRAINZ_3_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}I assume we have entered the second stage of research.
{EXCITED:winnie}Keep that in mind as we take part in this particular experiment.
{SAY:crazydave}The guys told me that they're studying some stuff.
{SAY:crazydave}The effects of cold environments in enhancing zombie's powers.
{SAY:winnie}User Dave, is it wise to aid zombies in researching more efficient ways to defeat us?
{EXCITED:crazydave}Nonsense, Penny! We all know that piercing cold has no way of boosting zombies!
{SAY:crazydave}The poor guy doing this research is probably in for the revision of a lifetime!
{SAY:winnie}Perhaps so, but they have unintentionally created an unrelated phenomenon.
{EXCITED:winnie}Have you ever heard of the butterfly effect?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_08_BIGBRAINZ_6_INTRO_: {EXCITED:crazydave}You need to keep your brain healthy and exercised to strengthen the flavor!
{TIRED:crazydave}Don't look at me like that! That's just what the zombies said.
{SAY:winnie}If that's the case, we have to make sure your brains are not on today's lunch special.
{SAY:winnie}These Gold Tiles will come in handy. Use them to your advantage.
{SAY:crazydave}I wonder what the brain exercise has to do with the tiles though...
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_08_BIGBRAINZ_8_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Shouldn't this be one of your frat zombies' research?
{TIRED:crazydave}I don't think so. They didn't say anything about this!
{SAY:winnie}Zombie formations are way too structured to be the work of university student.
{SAY:winnie}There's a high likelihood of a more intellectual interference.
{SAY:winnie}Please pay close attention to the way these zombies attack.
{SAY:winnie}I daresay it'll give us a clue to who's really behind all this.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_10_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}I finally found the source of all these- local boom of wilderness in my dwelling!
{SAY:zombossicon}And about time too! I've been meaning to delegate new tasks to her!
{SAY:zombossicon}Terrorizing you three! Do you think I have all the time in the world?
{SAY:zombossicon}There's schemes to be made, giant robots to construct-
{SAY:zombossicon}I do not have infinite leisure time to just spend on ruining your holidays! Big things are coming-
{SAY:zombossicon}So someone else has to occupy you for the time being!
{TIRED:crazydave}Aw, Boss Man, are you leaving us?
{SAY:zombossicon}What? No, never! I'm simply outsourcing my villainy to the lesser minions.
{SAY:zombossicon}Today's scheme is a work of hers- let's see how you fare against this!
{NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, it seems that the temperature has risen dramatically.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_10_INTRO_2: {SAY:crazydave}Wha- oh, you're right Penny- It's getting hot.
{SAY:winnie}Dr. Zomboss seems to have temporarily - and locally - broken the ozone layer right above our lawn.
{SAY:winnie}I suppose he has utilized the abundance of cattle waste to achieve this.
{SAY:crazydave}He's burning it and weaponizing it to make the weather hotter?
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}That's a double-edged sword! That means more sun for us!
{EXCITED:crazydave}Let's use all this sun to replant our arsenal, and restore that ozone thing!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_10_INTRO_4: {SAY:crazydave}Who's back? Boss Man, you're out of breath! What happened?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_10_INTRO_5: {SAY:zombossicon}You would also be out of breath after- cleaning out your lab from weasels and chickens-
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_10_INTRO_6: {SAY:zombossicon}Some of them are still hiding in my socks.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_10_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}To go back to the initial question - who is "she?"
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_10_INTRO_8: {SAY:zombossicon}A certain- general of mine. She has quite an affinity for animals- you might've noticed.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_10_INTRO_9: {SAY:zombossicon}I tasked her on a mission not too long ago, and she has returned.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_1_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Penny, I have something urgent to tell you.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_1_INTRO_10: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}I think we should go ahead and resupply! And what better time to do that than now?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_1_INTRO_11: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}It's the month of Harvest! Where plants bloom and the doom glooms.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_1_INTRO_12: {SAY:winnie}You are correct, User Dave. But data reserves show a certain obstacle regarding that.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_1_INTRO_14: {SAY:winnie}Well, that- but mainly the fact that some of our plants only grow in certain climates.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_1_INTRO_15: {SAY:winnie}We might need to travel the world - and in some cases through time - to refresh our stocks.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_1_INTRO_16: {EXCITED:crazydave}Then it's time for a road trip! Just two people and a talking RV passing the countryside!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_1_INTRO_17: {SAY:winnie}Yes, a trip is needed. But first, we need to clear these zombies out of the driveway.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_1_INTRO_18: {EXCITED:crazydave}We're not taking stowaways! Let's handle them, neighbor!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_1_INTRO_2: {TIRED:winnie}Is this about your attempt on creating a manure-powered field tiller?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_1_INTRO_3: {SAY:crazydave}No, Penny! I'm not playing around this time!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_1_INTRO_6: {TIRED:crazydave}That's on me. I've been going through our Winter Melon reserves.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_1_INTRO_7: {TIRED:crazydave}That's why they've been a bit weaker. The high quality seeds have gone out at this point.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_1_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}I see. You need not blame yourself, User Dave. This was partially my fault.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_1_INTRO_9: {TIRED:winnie}I wasn't keeping track of our inventory.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}User Dave, I've managed to gather a selection of seeds on our first trip.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_10: {SAY:winnie}These plants need time to grow. Make sure the zombies don't disrupt our crops while they bloom.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_11: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Yeah. Walking in on a plant that's blooming is just bad manners!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_2: {EXCITED:crazydave}Oooh! That's wonderful, Penny. We can start growing these in no time!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_3: {EXCITED:winnie}Correct. Your neighbor's front lawn has everything that a growing plant needs.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}But perfect humidity and moisture can only go so far in aiding our plant's growth-
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_6: {SAY:crazydave}I don't need pesticides! Stinky the Snail only eats chocolates!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}I am not talking about the gastropod, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}The pests in need of taking care of are zombies.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_4_INTRO_10: {SAY:winnie}That's right. We need to be vigilant. Zombies and dinosaurs are never a good combination.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_4_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}The logs show that our primal plant reserves are in short supply.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_4_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}Which is to be expected. Without our accidental interference, they're supposedly already extinct.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_4_INTRO_4: {SAY:crazydave}We can't have them extinct! They're so useful!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_4_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}While the sentiment applies to our exotic friends, other things from this period are meant to expire.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_4_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}I'm detecting unusual zombie activity in the area, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_4_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}They're aided, as usual, by the wildlife exclusive to this time period.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_6_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, I'm detecting unusual activity of wildlife.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_6_INTRO_2: {SAY:crazydave}Isn't that to be expected? We're in the Wild West!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_6_INTRO_3: {TIRED:winnie}To a certain extent, yes. However, my readings show numbers that exceed normal expectations.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_6_INTRO_4: {TIRED:winnie}We're looking at a 85% increase in likelihood of cattle stampedes.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_6_INTRO_5: {SAY:crazydave}Oh, that's 85% too many for my liking.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_6_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}Indeed. Most curious is that the zombies seem to have a hand in these botched odds.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_6_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}With their previous behavior riling up dinosaurs in the marsh, I have to wonder-
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_7_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}There's no mistaking it now, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_7_INTRO_10: {SAY:crazydave}Penny, we haven't gone through restocking all of our seed supplies yet!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_7_INTRO_11: {TIRED:crazydave}I can't let you use certain seeds. Some of them only have a single packet left!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_7_INTRO_12: {SAY:winnie}That is fine, User Dave. Your neighbor has proven to be very resourceful.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_7_INTRO_13: {EXCITED:winnie}I'm sure they'll manage to get through this, even with the imposed restrictions.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_7_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}It seems that we're not the only ones cultivating troops.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_7_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}The zombies seem to have taken an interest in expanding their roster of menageries.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_7_INTRO_4: {SAY:crazydave}Why, though? Are they also going through a shortage?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_7_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}Possibly. But it's all speculation at this point.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_7_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}Judging by patterns of behavior, Zomboss will certainly appear near the end of the month.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_7_INTRO_7: {EXCITED:crazydave} And that's when he'll spill the beans!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_7_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}Indeed. The only thing we can do in the meantime is to round up all his herded beasts.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_7_INTRO_9: {SAY:winnie}I suppose our collected selection of plants would be able to handle such a task.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_9_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Hello, hello? Is this blasted thing on?!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_9_INTRO_11: {SAY:zombossicon}Do not play dumb! Who else would stuff an entire zoo inside my lab?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_9_INTRO_12: {SAY:zombossicon}My operating table smells like manure and there's weasels in my unwashed boxers!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_9_INTRO_13: {SAY:winnie}We didn't do any of that. We're under the impression that you were building an army.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_9_INTRO_15: {SAY:zombossicon}Why would I do that? I've already had enough of these nasty things to go around!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_9_INTRO_17: {SAY:crazydave}So you weren't gathering those animals yourself?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_9_INTRO_18: {SAY:zombossicon}No! And if you two aren't behind this, then-
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_9_INTRO_2: {EXCITED:crazydave}Boss Man! Are you outside? I can hear mooing and hissing from your end.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_9_INTRO_21: {SAY:winnie}I do not know, User Dave. But a hinderance for Zomboss would prove useful to us.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_9_INTRO_22: {SAY:winnie}It seems he has left his stolen sun supply unoccupied whilst he deals with his furry little problem.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_9_INTRO_23: {SHOUT:crazydave}Sunlight! You can never have too much of that! Grass too! I love touching grass!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_9_INTRO_24: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}You should do the same when you get the chance, neighbor!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_9_INTRO_3: {SAY:zombossicon}What?! Speak up! I can't hear you! It's an entire jungle in here!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_9_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}Is there any reason for this transmission, Zomboss?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_9_INTRO_5: {SAY:zombossicon}Is that the machine speaking? Yes, I- no, you rotten critter, let go!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_9_INTRO_6: {TIRED:winnie}Even for your standards, that was rather crude.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_9_INTRO_8: {SAY:zombossicon}I wasn't- talking to you- AGH! Finally!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_9_INTRO_9: {SAY:zombossicon}This is all your fault! You must be behind this!
